# Why ChatGPT will be the next big growth channel (and how to capitalize on it) | Brian Balfour

## Transcript

Lenny Rachitsky (00:00:00):
Everyone's always complaining SEO's dead, it can't grow. Word of mouth is so hard.

Brian Balfour (00:00:03):
All of the ingredients for a new distribution platform are essentially happening [inaudible 00:00:07] right now. My prediction is that this becomes the dominant channel within eighteen months.

Lenny Rachitsky (00:00:14):
This is a huge opportunity for companies to get on it.

Brian Balfour (00:01:00):
The thing most people get wrong about growth is that they treat it as a set of tactics rather than a system. You have to understand your model, your market, and your channel together. If any one of those is misaligned the other two cannot compensate for it. I have watched dozens of companies try to fix a channel problem by hiring more marketers, and it never works, because the problem was never the channel.

Lenny Rachitsky (00:02:30):
So how would you diagnose which of the three is broken?

Brian Balfour (00:02:35):
Start with retention, always. Retention is the clearest signal of whether the product and the market actually fit together, and it is the number that everything else compounds on top of. If retention is flat after week four you have something. If it decays to zero you have a leaky bucket and no amount of acquisition spend will fill it.
